9.7.1. qnav.measurement.sensor

9.7.1.1. sensor.py

summary:

Defines the abstract base classes for sensor usage in simulations. This module contains the base classes for both sensors (used for taking GroundTruth records and producing measurements) and sensor fusion (methods for applying measurement information to the current estimated states).

author:

Michael Wright - mjwright@liverpool.ac.uk

version:

1.0.0 - First full implementation of class.

class qnav.measurement.sensor.Sensor(frequency: float, start_time: float = 0.0, rand_seed: int = None)[source]

Base class for sensors used in navigation. Defines the format of sensors used in the toolbox, specifically the methods, inputs and outputs expected for fusion and other classes.

abstract take_measurement(est_time: float, ground_truth: GroundTruth)[source]

Produces the measurement captured by the sensor. Given the current estimated time and the ground truth, this method shall return the measurement captured at that time. Alternatively, a None value can be returned to signify a measurement is not ready.

Parameters:

  • est_time (float) – The estimated time the measurement of the sensor is expected to be captured at (in seconds).

  • ground_truth (GroundTruth) – The corresponding ground truth data.

abstract property last_measurement: any

Returns the latest recorded measurement produced by sensor.

Returns:

Latest measurement produced by sensor.

Return type:

any

update(time_sec: float = None)[source]

Called on demand to update the sensor’s state. Typically called after measurements have been taken. When called this increases the next measurement time and propagates internal states, to the time difference.

Parameters:

time_sec (float) – The current simulation time in seconds.

property last_update: float

Returns the time (in seconds) of the last measurement.

Returns:

Time of last measurement (in seconds).

Return type:

float

property next_update: float

Returns the due time (in seconds) of the next measurement.

Returns:

Time of next measurement (in seconds).

Return type:

float

property frequency: float

Returns the sensor’s measurement frequency in Hz.

Returns:

The frequency in Hz.

Return type:

float

property time_step: float

Returns the sensor’s measurement time step in seconds.

Returns:

The measurement interval in seconds.

Return type:

float

class qnav.measurement.sensor.FusionTrigger(value, names=<not given>, *values, module=None, qualname=None, type=None, start=1, boundary=None)[source]

Flags used to indicate the triggering mode for fusion. These essentially define when fusion is triggered, subject to the sensor measurements that ara available.

class qnav.measurement.sensor.SensorFusion(trigger: FusionTrigger, *sensors: Sensor)[source]

Base class for a sensor fusion method used in navigation. Defines the format of data fusion used in the toolbox, specifically the methods, inputs and outputs expected.

property trigger: FusionTrigger

The selected trigger method for deciding when to apply fusion. This decides when fusion can be applied, subject to the available sensor measurements.

Returns:

The selected fusion trigger method.

Return type:

FusionTrigger

property sensors: Iterable[Sensor]

The provided sensors associated with the fusion method. This is a collection of all shared sensors whose measurements will be used by the fusion method.

Returns:

The shared sensors used by the fusion method.

Return type:

Iterable[Sensor]

abstract perform_fusion(estimated_state: EstimatedState) → None[source]

Performs the fusion with sensors and updates the estimated state. When called at scheduled time during a simulation loop, this method performs the data fusion by extracting last measurements from sensors and using them with the fusion algorithm to update the given current estimated state.

Parameters:

estimated_state (EstimatedState) – The current estimated states of the platform. This is what the fusion method will update.
